dct_description_sm: Data was collected in order to characterize the spatio-temporal variations in the Normalized Difference Vegetation Index (NDVI) values of different vegetation types, for the purpose of correlating NDVI values with Percent Vegetation Cover (PVC) and the fraction of Photosynthetically Active Radiation (fPAR), obtained from the point-frame and PAR measurements in the same vegetation plots. NDVI values were determined in 70 plots situated along 14 transects used to characterize the spatial variation in NDVI, as well as in 5 plots used to characterize the temporal variation in NDVI.
